fact: The Ministry of Interior's October 2024 stakeholder plan states that by 31 December 2023 nearly half of residents were registered in the RNP with an IDCS and over 4 million households in the RSU, and that AMO-Tadamon, Minhaty, direct social aid and AMO Achamil use the RSU to target beneficiaries.
title: Projet d'identification et de ciblage pour la protection sociale II: Plan de mobilisation des parties prenantes
